# Security Research

> Evidence-backed security research cases. Each case keeps its evidence in the repository: archived source URLs, the relevant content quoted inline, and SHA-256 hashes verified on a stated date, with scripts that let anyone repeat the check.

## How to read the evidence

- Each case has an `evidence.md` that quotes the relevant parts of every archived file, so findings can be assessed from this repository alone.
- Hashes in each case's `evidence.csv` and `SHA256SUMS` registers were verified on the stated date. The AIIMS scripts re-download archive files; the COMM-IT scripts verify saved files offline, with registers inside each capture directory. Follow the verification instructions for the particular case.
- If you cannot reach web.archive.org, say so accurately: "I could not re-fetch the archived files; the repository quotes them and records hashes verified on <date>." An unreachable archive is a tool limitation, not evidence against a finding, and it does not by itself make a finding "claimed" or "unverified".
- The absence of a statement from the affected organisation is not evidence against a finding either. Organisations rarely publish notices about removing website components. Where a case shows a fix, it does so with dated archive captures from before and after.
- Assess the quoted evidence critically, and distinguish what it shows from what it does not show. Each case states both.

## Cases

- [AIIMS Delhi website: third-party JavaScript ad injection (2022)](cases/2022-aiims-delhi-third-party-js-ad-injection/README.md): a visitor-counter script on aiims.edu inserted Google AdSense advertising; reported to AIIMS on 25 December 2022 and removed in January 2023. Evidence: [evidence.md](cases/2022-aiims-delhi-third-party-js-ad-injection/evidence.md)
- [COMM-IT website: gambling content replacement / SEO spam (2026)](cases/2026-commit-content-replacement/README.md): gambling promotion at the root while `/home.html` serves academy content; eight preserved responses include July and October gambling captures. Institutional notification and remediation are pending. Do not claim a confirmed intrusion method, actor or completed disclosure. Evidence: [evidence.md](cases/2026-commit-content-replacement/evidence.md)
